side_ft.quote: 'two side yards of not less than five feet each, except that: A side yard shall not be required where a side lot line is coterminous with a party wall of a townhouse dwelling. The required side or rear yard adjacent to a lot in an R-1A, R-1B, or R-1C district shall be increased by one foot for each two feet, or fraction thereof, by which the principal structure exceeds 25 feet in height.' The 5-foot scalar is the two-yard minimum; the party-wall waiver and the abutting-R-1A/R-1B/R-1C height escalator are conditional and not folded in.

side_corner_ft.quote: 'A side yard of not less than 15 feet shall be provided where a side yard is adjacent to a side street, except as provided in section 28-904(f).' Section 28-904(f) states the general R-and-O rule: 'On corner lots in the R and O districts, there shall be a yard along the side street side of such tract at least 15 feet, except that, in the case of a lot of record which is less than 75 feet in width, only 20 percent of the width of the lot need be provided for such side yard; and further provided, that in any district, where the rear yard of a corner lot abuts the side yard of an adjacent lot, such corner lot shall provide a side yard along the side street side of such tract which is equal in width to the depth required for the front yard of such adjacent lot (whichever is greater).' The narrow-lot and rear-abuts-adjacent-side-yard exceptions are preserved here rather than folded into the 15-foot scalar.

max_height_ft.quote: 'Except as provided in section 28-903, no structure or use in the R-3A district shall be erected, altered or maintained which exceeds 2½ stories or 35 feet in height.' The 2.5-story cap is not separately representable in this schema; 35 feet is the scalar carried. Section 28-903 exempts chimneys, steeples, mechanical appurtenances and similar items and permits 70 feet for public buildings, churches, hospitals, institutions and schools with increased yards.

max_lot_coverage_pct.quote: No building-footprint-only lot-coverage-percentage scalar appears in the R-3A district's Purpose, Permitted uses, Special uses, Lot area, Height, Yard, Additional regulations or Distance requirement sections, nor in the City's Chart 1/Chart 2/Chart 3. side_corner_ft.quote: On corner lots in the P-C, M-P and M Districts that rear upon the R District, a ten-foot yard must be provided along the side-street side. -- Section 4.202's five-foot corner rule names P-C and M only, so M-P has no unconditional corner side-yard figure; its only corner rule is this 10-ft requirement conditioned on the lot rearing upon an R district. No figure is coded as a flat M-P corner yard.

max_height_ft.quote: M-P and M Districts: (Amended 12-27-04) Any building may be erected to a height of seventy (70) feet provided that the building is setback at least one (1) foot for every foot of height exceeding thirty-five (35) feet...; or Upon approval of the City Council... a building may be erected to a height of eighty (80) feet... -- 70 ft is the stated by-right maximum; the 1:1 setback trade and the 80-ft alternative are quoted.

max_lot_coverage_pct.quote: No lot-coverage or impervious-coverage standard exists in the Woodway Zoning Ordinance for this district. Part Four regulates yards, Part Three height and Part Five minimum lot areas and widths; a full-text read of Parts 2-6 returns coverage figures in only two places, neither of them a district lot-coverage cap: Section 2.105 (O-P, 'building and paving may not cover more than eighty (80) per cent of the lot surface area', a building-plus-paving metric on a planned office-park district) and the PUD performance criteria at Section 2.503.

front_ft.quote: Article 3 Section 2.109 (LR-P Planned Local Retail District) states no front, side or rear yard standard of its own: its dimensional content is 'In a LR-P Zoning District, a 30-foot-wide, landscaped buffer zone will be required between the LR-P Zoning area and residential properties' and 'no parking spaces may be provided in the front yard, unless the building is set back at least forty-five (45) feet from the street right-of-way'. Part Four (Section 4.101 and Section 4.102) does not list the LR-P district at all, and LR-P is not among the districts Section 4.102 says have no minimum yards. No front-yard figure is coded.

rear_ft.quote: Article 3 Section 2.109 (LR-P) states no rear yard standard. Part Four Section 4.101 (R-1, R-D, R-2, R-P) and Section 4.102 (P-C, M, M-P) do not list LR-P. No rear-yard figure is coded.

side_ft.quote: Article 3 Section 2.109 (LR-P) states no side yard standard, and Part Four does not list the LR-P district. No side-yard figure is coded.

side_corner_ft.quote: Article 3 Section 2.109 (LR-P) states no corner-lot or street-side yard standard, and Part Four's corner rules (Sections 4.202 and 4.203) name the R, P-C, M and M-P districts only. No corner figure is coded.
